Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: ENVIRONMENTAL
Topic 4.1: Care CARE AND SAFETY

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Care CARE AND SAFETY. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Care CARE AND SAFETY.
2. Explain Care CARE AND SAFETY to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Care CARE AND SAFETY.
4. Show that you can: talk about materials and items used in cleaning their home and the immediate their classroom and immediate environment, clean their environment classroom
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Care CARE AND SAFETY. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Care CARE AND SAFETY important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
